## Hypothesis

The edge we are trying to capture is the ability to block PUT entries in an uptrend and CALL entries in a downtrend, using the `classify_trend` function from `crypto.lib.market_structure`. This veto aims to remove wrong-way trades, improving overall performance.

## Mechanism

The mechanism involves integrating the `classify_trend` function into the entry path, using it to classify the trend as uptrend, downtrend, or unknown. Based on this classification, the engine will either allow or block the entry, depending on the direction of the trade.
